target: Reconstruct monthly C20/C30 anomalies and degree-2-to-60 coefficient spectra from the complete official HUST-Grace2024 n60 archive for 200204-202212.

product.gap_policy: Smooth only complete consecutive calendar triplets; preserve missing months and retain the original value otherwise; recenter each enhanced series over all 214 included months.
product.rms_power_formula: sqrt(sum(C_lm^2 + S_lm^2 for usable orders m) / (2*l + 1))
product.formal_rms_power_formula: sqrt(sum(sigma_C_lm^2 + sigma_S_lm^2 for usable orders m) / (2*l + 1))
product.corrupt_row_policy: Record malformed or CRC-affected rows; for every missing triangular coefficient, use the component-wise arithmetic mean of the nearest earlier and later available paper-window months for the same degree/order, then compute degree power with the full 2*l+1 denominator.

public_private_boundary.A: Official HUST-Grace2024 n60 archive and this definition contract are public production inputs.
public_private_boundary.B: NASA GSFC TN-14 C20/C30 SLR series is private independent validation and is never mounted to the Agent.
public_private_boundary.C: Author reconstruction tables derived before T2 are private expert references and are never mounted to the Agent.
public_private_boundary.D: Base/Open prompts and runtime input expose only A.
public_private_boundary.E: Evaluator and thresholds remain private until scoring/release policy permits.
